```{r packages, message=FALSE}
# Read the preprocessed long data for raw fertility plots
```

## Raw Fertility Rates

```{r raw_fertility_plots}
# Helper function to create raw fertility plot for any subgroup
make_raw_group_plot <- function(df_long, group_name, group_label = NULL) {
  # Auto-generate label if not provided
  if (is.null(group_label)) {
    # Convert group name to readable label (e.g., hisp_usborn -> Hispanic US-born)
    group_label <- group_name %>%
      str_replace("_", " ") %>%
      str_to_title()
  }
  
  plot_df <- df_long %>%
    group_by(state) %>%
    mutate(ban_group = ifelse(any(exposed == 1), "Exposed (excl. Texas)", "Unexposed")) %>%
    mutate(ban_group = ifelse(is.na(ban_group), "Unexposed", ban_group)) %>%
    mutate(ban_group = ifelse(state == "TX", "Texas", ban_group)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(group == group_name) %>%
    group_by(ban_group, time) %>%
    summarize(
      births = sum(births, na.rm = TRUE),
      population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(birthrate = births / population * 1000 * 6)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time, y = birthrate, color = ban_group)) +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, span = 0.5) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Exposed (excl. Texas)" = "red", "Texas" = "orange", "Unexposed" = "dark gray"),
      labels = c("Exposed (excl. Texas)" = "States with bans (excl. Texas)", 
                 "Texas" = "Texas", 
                 "Unexposed" = "States without bans"),
      name = ""
    ) +
    ylab("Fertility rate") +
    xlab("Year") +
    ggtitle(group_label) +
    scale_x_date(
      date_breaks = "1 year",
      date_labels = "%Y",
      limits = c(as.Date("2015-12-01"), as.Date("2023-08-01"))
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2022-01-01"), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2023-01-01"), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text(x = as.Date("2022-02-01"), y = 68, label = "Texas exposure in effect", 
              vjust = 1, angle = 90, color = "orange", size = 3.5) +
    geom_text(x = as.Date("2023-02-01"), y = 68, label = "Other exposures in effect", 
              vjust = 1, angle = 90, color = "red", size = 3.5) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(as.Date("2015-12-01"), as.Date("2023-04-01"))) +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.75, 0.99), legend.justification = c(1, 1))
}

# Get unique groups from data and create plots for each
unique_groups <- unique(df_long$group)
cat(sprintf("Creating raw fertility plots for groups: %s\n", paste(unique_groups, collapse = ", ")))
```

## Load Plotting Functions and Stitch Models

```{r load_plot_utilities}
source("plot_utilities.R")

# Define types and ranks (like dobbs_fertility)
# This will automatically detect which types have been run
types <- c("total", "groups")
ranks <- c(10, 10)  # Rank for each type

file_dir <- "results/"

# Initialize combined samples
all_samples <- tibble()

# Loop over types and stitch together (EXACTLY like dobbs_fertility)
for(i in 1:length(types)) {
  type <- types[i]
  model_rank <- ranks[i]
  
  print(sprintf("Loading %s model (rank %i)", type, model_rank))
  
  # Load model output for this type (generic naming: NB_births_{type}_{rank}.csv)
  type_samples <- read_csv(sprintf("%s/NB_births_%s_%i.csv", file_dir, type, model_rank))
  
  # Apply thinning if needed
  if (".draw" %in% names(type_samples) && thin_factor > 1) {
    type_samples <- type_samples %>% filter(.draw %% thin_factor == 0)
  }
  
  # Ensure TX has banned_state = 1 (it's a treated state but may not be flagged)
  type_samples <- type_samples %>%
    mutate(banned_state = ifelse(state == "TX" | banned_state == 1, 1, banned_state))
  
  # For groups model (K>1), add aggregated "Total" category FIRST (before creating Ban States)
  # This ensures Ban States also include the Total category
  if (type == "groups") {
    df_total_category <- type_samples %>%
      group_by(.draw, .chain, .iteration, N, state, D, time, start_date, end_date, year, bmcode, exposure_code, banned_state, exposed) %>%
      summarize(
        births = sum(births),
        population = sum(population),
        ypred = sum(ypred),
        mu = log(sum(exp(mu))),
        mu_treated = log(sum(exp(mu_treated))),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        group = "total",
        category = "total",
        K = max(type_samples$K, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
      )
    
    type_samples <- bind_rows(type_samples, df_total_category)
    rm(df_total_category)
  }
  
  # Get list of states with bans from this type's data
  states_with_bans_type <- type_samples %>%
    filter(exposure_code == 1) %>%
    pull(state) %>%
    unique()
  
  # Find minimum treatment time for non-TX states
  ban_no_tx_treat_time <- type_samples %>%
    filter(state != "TX", state %in% states_with_bans_type, exposure_code == 1) %>%
    pull(time) %>% min()
  
  # Create "Ban States" aggregate (INCLUDING Texas) for this type
  df_ban_states <- type_samples %>%
    filter(state %in% states_with_bans_type) %>%
    group_by(.draw, .chain, .iteration, K, N, category, time, start_date, end_date, year, bmcode, group) %>%
    summarize(
      births = sum(births),
      population = sum(population),
      ypred = sum(ypred),
      mu = log(sum(exp(mu))),
      mu_treated = log(sum(exp(mu_treated))),
      exposure_code = max(exposure_code),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(state = "Ban States", banned_state = 1, exposed = max(exposure_code), 
           D = max(type_samples$D, na.rm = TRUE) + 1)
  
  # Create "Ban States (excl. Texas)" by subtracting Texas FROM "Ban States" (like original)
  # Must preserve group/category alignment for proper row-wise subtraction
  df_tx <- type_samples %>% filter(state == "TX") %>%
    select(.draw, .chain, .iteration, category, time, group,
           ypred_tx = ypred, mu_tx = mu, mu_treated_tx = mu_treated, 
           population_tx = population, births_tx = births)
  
  df_ban_no_tx <- df_ban_states %>%
    left_join(df_tx, by = c(".draw", ".chain", ".iteration", "category", "time", "group")) %>%
    mutate(
      state = "Ban States (excl. Texas)",
      banned_state = 1,
      exposure_code = ifelse(time >= ban_no_tx_treat_time, 1, 0),
      ypred = ypred - ypred_tx,
      mu = log(exp(mu) - exp(mu_tx)),
      mu_treated = log(exp(mu_treated) - exp(mu_treated_tx)),
      population = population - population_tx,
      births = births - births_tx,
      D = max(type_samples$D, na.rm = TRUE) + 2,
      exposed = exposure_code
    ) %>%
    select(-ends_with("_tx"))
  
  # Bind both Ban States aggregates to this type's samples
  type_samples <- bind_rows(type_samples, df_ban_states, df_ban_no_tx)
  
  # Tag with type and rank
  type_samples$type <- type
  type_samples$rank <- model_rank
  
  # Bind to combined samples
  all_samples <- bind_rows(all_samples, type_samples)
  
  rm(type_samples, df_ban_states, df_ban_no_tx, df_tx)
  gc()
}

print(sprintf("Combined all_samples shape: %d rows", nrow(all_samples)))
print(sprintf("Types: %s", paste(unique(all_samples$type), collapse=", ")))

# Compute treatment effect (te = mu_treated - mu)
all_samples <- all_samples %>%
  mutate(te = mu_treated - mu)

# Recode category labels (keep type around!)
# Auto-generate readable labels from group names
all_samples <- all_samples %>%
  mutate(category_label = case_when(
    category == "total" ~ "Total",
    category == "usborn" ~ "US-born",
    category == "foreign" ~ "Foreign-born",
    category == "hisp_usborn" ~ "Hispanic US-born",
    category == "hisp_foreign" ~ "Hispanic Foreign-born",
    category == "nh_usborn" ~ "Non-Hispanic US-born",
    category == "nh_foreign" ~ "Non-Hispanic Foreign-born",
    TRUE ~ str_replace(category, "_", " ") %>% str_to_title()  # Generic fallback
  ))

# Keep category as the raw group name for filtering/joining
# Use category_label for display

# Compute quantiles from the stitched all_samples
quantiles_df <- all_samples %>% 
  group_by(type, category, category_label, state, time) %>%
  summarize(
    ypred_mean = mean(ypred), 
    ypred_lower = quantile(ypred, 0.025), 
    ypred_upper = quantile(ypred, 0.975), 
    births = mean(births), 
    exposure_code = first(exposure_code),
    banned_state = first(banned_state),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Individual State Tables and Plots

```{r state_tables, results='asis'}
# Create tables directory structure
dir.create("figs/supplement_figures/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Get list of treated states
state_and_treat_times <- all_samples %>% 
  filter(exposure_code == 1, state != "Ban States", state != "Ban States (excl. Texas)") %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarize(treatment_start = min(time), .groups = "drop")

treated_states <- state_and_treat_times %>% pull(state)
treated_times <- state_and_treat_times %>% pull(treatment_start)

for (i in seq_along(treated_states)) {
  target_state <- treated_states[i]
  
  # Skip if target_state is invalid
  if (is.na(target_state) || target_state == "") next
  
  if (target_state == "Ban States (excl. Texas)") {
    tab_caption <- sprintf(
      "Supplementary Table %i. Estimated difference in cumulative observed vs expected births (count and rate) in all banned states excluding Texas (January 2023 through December 2023), overall and by subgroup. * denotes categories for which the 95%% credible intervals excludes zero.", 
      i
    )
  } else {
    tab_caption <- sprintf(
      "Supplementary Table %i. Estimated difference in cumulative observed vs expected births (count and rate) in %s (%s %s through December 2023), overall and by subgroup. * denotes categories for which the 95%% credible intervals excludes zero.", 
      i, target_state, month(treated_times[i], label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE), year(treated_times[i])
    )
  }
  
  # Use all_samples for state tables (includes both total and groups)
  state_table <- make_fertility_table(all_samples, target_state = target_state, target = "births", 
                      denom = "population", tab_caption = tab_caption)
  
  # Render table in loop using as_raw_html with results='asis'
  cat(as_raw_html(state_table))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  state_table %>% gtsave(filename = sprintf("figs/supplement_figures/tables/%s_table.png", target_state), zoom = 4)
  
  # Use total model for fit/gap plots
  p_state_fit <- make_state_fit_plot(quantiles_df %>% filter(type == "total"), 
                      state_name = target_state, category = "Total", target = "births") + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) + 
    ggtitle(paste("Model Fit -", target_state, sep = " "))
  print(p_state_fit)
  ggsave(
    filename = sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/fit_and_gap_plots/%s_fit_plot.%s", fig_prefix, target_state, fig_format), 
    width = 8, height = 5
  )
  
  p_state_gap <- make_gap_plot(quantiles_df %>% filter(type == "total"), 
                state_name = target_state, category = "Total", target = "births") + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) + 
    ggtitle(paste("Gap Plot -", target_state, sep = " "))
  print(p_state_gap)
  ggsave(
    sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/fit_and_gap_plots/%s_gap_plot.%s", fig_prefix, target_state, fig_format), 
    width = 8, height = 5
  )
}
```

## Aggregation Computations for Paper

```{r aggregations}
file.create("figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", overwrite=TRUE)

## MCMC Diagnostics (Effective Sample Size)
all_samples %>% filter(!is.na(te), exposure_code == 1) %>% 
  group_by(state, time, category) %>% 
  summarize(es=coda::effectiveSize(te), .groups="drop") %>% 
  pull(es) %>% quantile(., c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

## Trace plots
all_samples %>% filter(exposure_code == 1, time=="2023-05-01") %>% 
  mutate(.iteration = .draw %% max(.draw/.chain)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=.iteration, y=te)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color=as.factor(.chain)), alpha=0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~category + state, scales="free") + 
  theme_bw()
ggsave("figs/supplement_figures/trace_plot_2023_05_01.png", width=30, height=30)

### Variance Decomposition
ci_df <- all_samples %>% 
  filter(exposure_code == 1) %>% 
  mutate(denom = population, 
         years=interval(start_date, end_date) / years(1)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(state, type, category, .draw) %>% 
  summarize(
    ypred = sum(ypred),
    outcome = sum(births), 
    years = mean(years),
    treated = sum(exp(mu_treated)), 
    untreated = sum(exp(mu)),
    denom = sum(denom * years, na.rm = TRUE),
    treated_rate = treated / denom * 1000,
    untreated_rate = untreated / denom * 1000,
    outcome_rate = round(outcome / denom * 100, 2),
    outcome_diff = round(treated - untreated),
    causal_effect_ratio = treated_rate / untreated_rate,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ci_df %>% 
  group_by(state, category) %>% 
  summarize(median_ratio = median(causal_effect_ratio), .groups="drop") %>% 
  group_by(category) %>% 
  mutate(effect_rank = rank(median_ratio)) %>% 
  filter(!(state %in% c("Ban States", "Ban States (excl. Texas)"))) %>% 
  mutate(state = fct_reorder(state, effect_rank, .fun=mean)) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  ggdist::geom_dots(aes(y=state, x=effect_rank), binwidth = unit(c(2, Inf), "mm"))
  
ci_df_mean <- ci_df %>% 
  group_by(type, category, state) %>% 
  summarize(causal_effect_ratio = mean(causal_effect_ratio), .groups="drop")

ci_df_mean %>% 
  filter(type != "total") %>% 
  group_by(type) %>% 
  summarize(adj_r_squared = summary(lm(causal_effect_ratio ~ category))$adj.r.squared, .groups="drop") -> rsquared_df

write_lines("------ Adjusted R-squareds based on Category ------- ", 
            "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
write_lines(capture.output(print(rsquared_df)), 
            "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)

## Compute the causal effect for southern states vs northern states
region_df <- all_samples %>% 
  filter(!state %in% c("Ban States", "Ban States (excl. Texas)")) %>% 
  mutate(region = ifelse(state %in% c("WI", "SD", "ID", "MO"), "Nonsouth", "South"))

region_df <- region_df %>%
  filter(exposure_code == 1) %>% 
  group_by(type, category, .draw, time, region) %>% 
  summarise(births = sum(births), 
            denom = sum(population), 
            ypred=sum(ypred), 
            mu = log(sum(exp(mu))),
            mu_treated = log(sum(exp(mu_treated))),
            years=mean(interval(start_date, end_date) / years(1)),
            .groups="drop")

region_df %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(region, .draw) %>%
  summarize(
    ypred = sum(ypred),
    outcome = sum(births), 
    years = mean(years),
    treated = sum(exp(mu_treated)), 
    untreated = sum(exp(mu)),
    denom = sum(denom * years, na.rm = TRUE),
    treated_rate = treated / denom * 1000,
    untreated_rate = untreated / denom * 1000,
    outcome_rate = round(outcome / denom * 100, 2),
    outcome_diff = round(treated - untreated),
    causal_effect_ratio = treated_rate / untreated_rate,
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = c(causal_effect_ratio), id_cols=c(.draw)) %>% 
  mutate(causal_effect_ratio_diff = South - Nonsouth) %>% 
  summarize(
    mean_rate_south = mean(South), 
    mean_rate_nonsouth = mean(Nonsouth),
    mean_diff = mean(causal_effect_ratio_diff), 
    lower_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.025), 
    upper_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.975),
    pr_south_greater = mean(South > Nonsouth)
  ) -> pr_south_greater

write_lines("------ Posterior Prob Southern vs Non-Southern States ------- ", 
            "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
write_lines(capture.output(print(pr_south_greater)), 
            "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)

## Compute Effect Differences for Groups (adapt based on which groups are in the data)
groups_df <- all_samples %>% 
  filter(!state %in% c("Ban States", "Ban States (excl. Texas)")) %>% 
  filter(type == "groups") %>% 
  filter(exposure_code == 1) %>%
  group_by(type, category, .draw, time) %>% 
  summarise(births = sum(births), 
            denom = sum(births), 
            ypred=sum(ypred), 
            mu = log(sum(exp(mu))),
            mu_treated = log(sum(exp(mu_treated))),
            years=mean(interval(start_date, end_date) / years(1)),
            .groups="drop")

groups_causal <- groups_df %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(category, .draw) %>%
  summarize(
    ypred = sum(ypred),
    outcome = sum(births), 
    years = mean(years),
    treated = sum(exp(mu_treated)), 
    untreated = sum(exp(mu)),
    denom = sum(denom * years, na.rm = TRUE),
    treated_rate = treated / denom * 1000,
    untreated_rate = untreated / denom * 1000,
    outcome_rate = round(outcome / denom * 100, 2),
    outcome_diff = round(treated - untreated),
    causal_effect_ratio = treated_rate / untreated_rate,
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = c(causal_effect_ratio), id_cols=c(.draw))

# Check which groups are available and compute relevant comparisons
available_groups <- names(groups_causal)[names(groups_causal) != ".draw"]
cat(sprintf("\nAvailable groups for comparison: %s\n", paste(available_groups, collapse = ", ")))

# If we have usborn and foreign, compare them
if (all(c("usborn", "foreign") %in% available_groups)) {
  groups_causal %>% 
    mutate(causal_effect_ratio_diff = foreign - usborn) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    summarize(
      mean_rate_usborn = mean(usborn), 
      mean_rate_foreign = mean(foreign),
      mean_diff = mean(causal_effect_ratio_diff), 
      lower_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.025), 
      upper_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.975),
      pr_foreign_greater = mean(foreign > usborn)
    ) -> pr_foreign_greater
  
  write_lines("------ Posterior Prob Foreign-born > US-born ------- ", 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  write_lines(capture.output(print(pr_foreign_greater)), 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  print(pr_foreign_greater)
}

# If we have hisp_usborn and hisp_foreign, compare them
if (all(c("hisp_usborn", "hisp_foreign") %in% available_groups)) {
  groups_causal %>% 
    mutate(causal_effect_ratio_diff = hisp_foreign - hisp_usborn) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    summarize(
      mean_rate_hisp_usborn = mean(hisp_usborn), 
      mean_rate_hisp_foreign = mean(hisp_foreign),
      mean_diff = mean(causal_effect_ratio_diff), 
      lower_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.025), 
      upper_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.975),
      pr_hisp_foreign_greater = mean(hisp_foreign > hisp_usborn)
    ) -> pr_hisp_foreign_greater
  
  write_lines("------ Posterior Prob Hispanic Foreign-born > Hispanic US-born ------- ", 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  write_lines(capture.output(print(pr_hisp_foreign_greater)), 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  print(pr_hisp_foreign_greater)
}

# If we have nh_usborn and nh_foreign, compare them
if (all(c("nh_usborn", "nh_foreign") %in% available_groups)) {
  groups_causal %>% 
    mutate(causal_effect_ratio_diff = nh_foreign - nh_usborn) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    summarize(
      mean_rate_nh_usborn = mean(nh_usborn), 
      mean_rate_nh_foreign = mean(nh_foreign),
      mean_diff = mean(causal_effect_ratio_diff), 
      lower_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.025), 
      upper_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.975),
      pr_nh_foreign_greater = mean(nh_foreign > nh_usborn)
    ) -> pr_nh_foreign_greater
  
  write_lines("------ Posterior Prob Non-Hispanic Foreign-born > Non-Hispanic US-born ------- ", 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  write_lines(capture.output(print(pr_nh_foreign_greater)), 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  print(pr_nh_foreign_greater)
}

# Cross-ethnicity comparison: Hispanic vs Non-Hispanic (if all 4 groups available)
if (all(c("hisp_usborn", "hisp_foreign", "nh_usborn", "nh_foreign") %in% available_groups)) {
  groups_causal %>% 
    mutate(
      hisp_total = hisp_usborn + hisp_foreign,
      nh_total = nh_usborn + nh_foreign,
      causal_effect_ratio_diff = hisp_total - nh_total
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    summarize(
      mean_rate_hisp = mean(hisp_total), 
      mean_rate_nh = mean(nh_total),
      mean_diff = mean(causal_effect_ratio_diff), 
      lower_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.025), 
      upper_diff = quantile(causal_effect_ratio_diff, 0.975),
      pr_hisp_greater = mean(hisp_total > nh_total)
    ) -> pr_hisp_vs_nh
  
  write_lines("------ Posterior Prob Hispanic > Non-Hispanic (Combined) ------- ", 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  write_lines(capture.output(print(pr_hisp_vs_nh)), 
              "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
  print(pr_hisp_vs_nh)
}

## Portion of excess births in Texas from pre Dobbs period
texas_df <- all_samples %>% 
  filter(exposure_code == 1, state == "Texas", type == "total") %>% 
  mutate(denom = population, pre_dobbs = time < "2023-01-01") 
                          
texas_df %>% 
  mutate(denom = population * interval(start_date, end_date) / years(1)) %>%
  group_by(pre_dobbs, .draw) %>%
  summarize(
    ypred = sum(ypred),
    outcome = sum(ifelse(is.na(births), round(exp(mu)), births)), 
    treated = sum(exp(mu_treated)), 
    untreated = sum(exp(mu)),
    denom = sum(denom, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(outcome_diff = round(treated - untreated)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pre_dobbs) %>%
  summarize(
    outcome = round(mean(outcome), digits=ifelse(mean(outcome < 1), 2, 0)),
    outcome_diff_mean = round(mean(outcome_diff), digits=ifelse(mean(outcome < 1), 2, 0)), 
    outcome_diff_lower = round(quantile(outcome_diff, 0.025)), 
    outcome_diff_upper = round(quantile(outcome_diff, 0.975)),
    .groups="drop"
  ) -> texas_summary

excess_births_pre <- texas_summary$outcome_diff_mean[texas_summary$pre_dobbs == TRUE]
excess_births_post <- texas_summary$outcome_diff_mean[texas_summary$pre_dobbs == FALSE]

write_lines("------ Fraction excess TX births from Pre Dobbs period ------- ", 
            "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
write_lines(sprintf("Pre Dobbs: %i (%f), Post Dobbs: %i (%f)", 
                    excess_births_pre, excess_births_pre/(excess_births_pre + excess_births_post),
                    excess_births_post, excess_births_post/(excess_births_pre + excess_births_post)),
            "figs/main_figures/summaries_for_paper.txt", append=TRUE)
```

## Posterior Predictive Checks (PPCs) for Rank Selection

```{r ppc_figures}
# Create PPC directory structure
dir.create("figs/supplement_figures/ppc", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ppc_states <- c("TX", "Ban States (excl. Texas)")

for(t in types) {
  
  # Get categories for this type
  type_categories <- unique(all_samples$category[all_samples$type == t])
  figure_height = 10 * (length(type_categories) + 1) / 5

  print(sprintf("Generating PPC plots for %s model...", t))
  
  # RMSE PPC
  rmse_res <- make_rmse_ppc_plot(all_samples %>% filter(state %in% ppc_states, type == t), outcome="births")
  print(rmse_res$rmse_plt)
  ggsave(rmse_res$rmse_plt, filename=sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/ppc/%s_rmse_plot.png", fig_prefix, t), width=10, height=figure_height)

  # Absolute residuals PPC
  abs_res <- make_abs_res_ppc_plot(all_samples %>% filter(state %in% ppc_states, type == t), outcome="births")
  print(abs_res$max_plt)
  ggsave(abs_res$max_plt, filename=sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/ppc/%s_abs_plot.png", fig_prefix, t), width=10, height=figure_height)

  # ACF PPC plots for different lags
  acf_ppc6 <- make_acf_ppc_plot(all_samples %>% filter(state %in% ppc_states, type == t),
                  lag=6, outcome="births") 
  print(acf_ppc6$acf_plt)
  ggsave(acf_ppc6$acf_plt, filename=sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/ppc/%s_acf6_plot.png", fig_prefix, t), width=10, height=figure_height)

  acf_ppc3 <- make_acf_ppc_plot(all_samples %>% filter(state %in% ppc_states, type == t),
                  lag=3, outcome="births") 
  print(acf_ppc3$acf_plt)
  ggsave(acf_ppc3$acf_plt, filename=sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/ppc/%s_acf3_plot.png", fig_prefix, t), width=10, height=figure_height)

  acf_ppc1 <- make_acf_ppc_plot(all_samples %>% filter(state %in% ppc_states, type == t), 
                                lag=1, outcome="births") 
  print(acf_ppc1$acf_plt)
  ggsave(acf_ppc1$acf_plt, filename=sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/ppc/%s_acf1_plot.png", fig_prefix, t), width=10, height=figure_height)

  # Unit correlation PPC
  uc_ppcs_obj <- make_unit_corr_ppc_plot(all_samples %>% filter(type == t), outcome="births")
  print(uc_ppcs_obj$eval_plt)
  ggsave(uc_ppcs_obj$eval_plt, filename=sprintf("figs/%ssupplement_figures/ppc/%s_unit_corr_plot.png", fig_prefix, t), width=7, height=figure_height)

}

print("PPC plots generated for rank selection analysis")
```
